note: EXPERIMENT — hardware spec comparison prototype. Static specs curated from vendor spec sheets (each row cites its source URL, verified reachable 2026-09-14). NOT part of the evidence-judged arenas: no user stories, no probes, no LLM judging. AI-compute figures are NOT comparable across rows — vendors quote different precisions and sparsity; the precision is stated per row. Values marked derived are computed from the cited spec (formula in the note).
